item.text: {"summary":"Draft is mostly coherent, but publication should confirm the required structured announcement-fetch event and tighten the interval-method language around volatility versus ladder elicitation.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"resolver","severity":"blocking","summary":"The reasoning says the required thesis_announcement_fetch tool was used, but the draft only shows an official.lookup entry, not a structured thesis_announcement_fetch.fetch_official_announcement event for the exact officialAnnouncementUrl.","actionRequested":"Ensure the trace contains a successful structured call to thesis_announcement_fetch.fetch_official_announcement with https://legacy.sba.gov/document/report-small-business-administration-loan-program-performance exactly; do not rely on prose or the official.lookup citation as a substitute."},{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The 80% interval is attributed to the elicited ladder, but the interval-size justification does not quantify realized volatility or explicitly state why the ladder alone is the uncertainty method.","actionRequested":"Add one compact sentence naming the historical sample used for uncertainty and either a realized-volatility check or an explicit statement that the ladder-derived 10th/90th percentiles are the interval method with methodology-transition widening."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Mention whether any newer SBA FY2025 annual or FY2026 interim old-methodology print was checked and excluded, since the run date is 2026-08-08.","Clarify that the point estimate is the ladder median, not a mean, if the schema expects pointEstimate to be interpreted that way."]}
